sentences.text:
This is the sixth application filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 relating to FIR No. 89/2020 registered at P.S-Khategaon,
District- Dewas (M.P.) for the offence under sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and section 5(L) / 6 of POCSO Act.

2/ Learned counsel for the applicant contended that after rejection of earlier two bail applications,
Dr. Megha Patil (PW-14) has been examined before the trial Court and has stated in her statement that no external and internal injury was found on the body of the prosecutrix and no sign of forceful rape has been found also.
The appellant is suffering jail incarceration since 16/03/2020.
Final conclusion will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstance, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned PL for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer and prays for its rejection stating that the applicant's earlier two bail applications were dismissed on merit vide order dated 22/11/2021 and 02/11/2022 and after that, there is no change in circumstances, therefore, he does not deserve for grant of bail.
4/ Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by both the parties as also taking note of the fact that as per the scholar register, date of birth of the prosecutrix is 05/03/2002 and she was minor at the time of the incident; the prosecutrix and all other witnesses have been examined before the trial Court and they have supported the case of prosecution; there is no material change in the circumstances, in which the applicant may be granted bail.
5/ In light of the above, present sixth bail application field under section 439 of Cr.P.C by the applicant has no force and is hereby dismissed.
CC
